project.name: jawelte (testcontrol-module aggregator)
project.description: Convenience annotation @TestControl that binds per-method scope filtering (startScopes) and database-fixture handling (testData = dbIn/ + dbUpdate/ + dbExpected/) into a single annotation, plus an unconditional CDI-bootstrap remap of @ConfigBean from @ApplicationScoped to @TestClassScoped. testcontrol-module/api ships only the annotation; testcontrol-module/impl ships the TestModuleLifecyclePort adapter (@Priority(50)), the CDI Extension that performs the remap, the BeforeScopeStarted observer that applies the startScopes veto, and the TestDataHandler that drives the four-phase seed -> commit -> verify pipeline through TICKET-009's DbSeed / DbDiff and TICKET-005's PersistenceUnitConnectionResolver.
